mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) level is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as it reflects accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates and supports equity valuations.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 5.0% signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling does not produce positive 60-day returns in > 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening demand for new homes and potential economic slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances when HOUST declines during late-cycle expansion, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as it reflects strong manufacturing output that supports corporate profit growth.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for INDPRO remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 5-day returns in high INDPRO periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts (HOUST) level below 1500 signals a contraction in the housing market that reduces consumer confidence and corporate revenue, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 1500, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of CPIAUCSL rising and FEDFUNDS rising does not produce negative 20-day returns in > 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime, a decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate revenue, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS declines during high-unemployment, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
